declined.description: Set when the corpus cannot support an answer. Says what is missing.
declined.title: Declined

Artifact.description: What was computed, kept so it can be read and replayed.
Artifact.title: Artifact

AuditEntry.description:
One row of the audit table (OF-BLD-015 §7.3): a write a model, an MCP
client or a named person made, a proposal a person carried out or
dismissed, or a request that named its own key. `agent` is `model` for a
model's or an assistant's write and `person` for a person's; `who` names
it, an MCP client by its `<name>/<version>`. A row of the model's lane
names the door its write came in by in `detail.via`: `postdoc` (Postdoc's
loop), `mcp` (the MCP server in its own process) or `http` (the tool
door's X-OpenFerment-Assistant header).

askId.description: The ask of Postdoc's the write was part of; empty for a write from outside an ask.
askId.title: Askid

at.description: When the row was written, ISO 8601 in UTC (`+00:00`).
at.title: At

detail.description: What the write was, by the action's own names (the tool, the kind, a note), and, for a write of the model's lane, the door it came in by (`via`: postdoc, mcp or http).
detail.title: Detail

effort.description: The effort the service's model ran at, for a write of Postdoc's; empty for a person's write and for an outside assistant's, since no model of the service ran for it.
effort.title: Effort

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry

AuditEvent.description: One entry in a record's audit trail. Mirrors the browser's AuditEvent.
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

Band.description: One series' band for readings: the 5th to 95th percentile, and the median.
Band.title: Band

BoundRecord.description: One record an input was bound to, in the input's unit.
BoundRecord.title: BoundRecord

Candidate.description:
An extraction the anchoring rules accepted (§2.4), before any human has
looked at it. Mirrors the browser's ExtractionRecord minus the four fields
review owns — audit, gold, corrected, reviewer — because a candidate has
no review history yet and must not be able to claim one.

Provenance and status are fixed at 'unverified' by construction. The model
does not get a slot to set either.
Candidate.title: Candidate

CatalogueEntry.description: One entry of a project's catalogue; the fields a kind does not use stay empty.
CatalogueEntry.title: CatalogueEntry

CatalogueIntake.description: What a file of entries came to: the ids kept, and each row refused with why.
CatalogueIntake.title: CatalogueIntake

CatalogueKeep.description: POST /api/catalogues/{kind}: one entry and who keeps it.
CatalogueKeep.title: CatalogueKeep

CeilingCheck.description:
GET /api/proforma/ceiling-check: one scenario's fermenter yield beside
every stored ceiling of its organism's shelf models on its sugar.
CeilingCheck.title: CeilingCheck

CeilingRow.description:
One stored ceiling beside the scenario's yield, both on the ceiling's
own footing, grams of product per gram of sugar and mol per mol.
CeilingRow.title: CeilingRow

CheckBrief.description:
What the model suggests the assessor watch for. Steps and criteria are
references the service resolves; questions are words with no number.
CheckBrief.title: CheckBrief

CheckCriterion.description:
One of a skill's mastery criteria, by its place in the skill's list
(Guild's skills; none ship with alpha 2.0).
CheckCriterion.title: CheckCriterion

CheckNote.description: The assessor's own words on one skill, kept verbatim as the entry's raw.
CheckNote.title: CheckNote

CheckReason.description: Why a check is proposed, written by fixed rules from the ledger.
CheckReason.title: CheckReason

CheckResult.description: The assessor's call on one criterion, with their own words.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

Checks.description: A project's checks — every check proposed, asked for, run or dismissed.
Checks.title: Checks

Claim.description: One assertion, and everything it rests on.

text.description: Prose with NO number in it. Name what was measured and under what conditions; the interface renders the value from the cited record.
text.title: Text

Claim.title: Claim

ClaimValue.description:
A number a claim states, apart from its words (ADR-006): what it is,
and the quantity with its origin, which the validator computes from what
the plan names. A value read from a computed value or a record names it
in `source` and carries that origin; the answering model's estimate
carries `model-estimate` with the model's id, and the claim that states
it is `assumed`.
ClaimValue.title: ClaimValue

CollectOutcome.description:
What Intake did with one document (ADR-002): `ingested`, stored in the
kit for the first time; `linked`, the kit held the same text already and
the project now holds it too; `held`, the project held it before;
`failed`, nothing stored, and `reason` says why. `transient` marks a
failure that was the network's condition, worth asking again.
CollectOutcome.title: CollectOutcome

CollectRequest.description:
POST /api/intake/collect: a paper, a report or a strain entry by its
identifier (a PMCID, a DOI, `PMID:<id>`, `OSTI:<id>`, `SGD:<SGDID>`, an
osti.gov or a yeastgenome.org address), who asked, and why.
CollectRequest.title: CollectRequest

ComparisonCreate.description:
POST /api/studies/comparisons: the engine runs to set side by side, in
the order the comparison reads them (the first is the one each change is
reckoned from).
ComparisonCreate.title: ComparisonCreate

ComparisonReport.description:
GET /api/studies/comparisons/{id}: the comparison and its artifact,
whose output holds the runs, the rows and the values each run set.
ComparisonReport.title: ComparisonReport

CoverageHit.description: One row of one module that the question names.
CoverageHit.title: CoverageHit

CoverageMap.description: The sweep, module by module, in the order the rail lists them.
CoverageMap.title: CoverageMap

DecisionCheck.description:
What `POST /api/biorepo/check` answers (OF-BLD-012.1 F1.5): whether
`biorepo.write` would store this decision, and the rule it would refuse
it under. The browser asks before the reviewer presses the key, so the
screen says what the service would say rather than a mirror of it.
DecisionCheck.title: DecisionCheck

Deposition.description:
The bench's record of a run against a runbook (mirrors `Deposition` in
src/data/types.ts): its readings and observations, appended as they are
taken, its state from staged to running to closed, and its
reconciliation. A write to one the project keeps is held to what the
bench does (`project_state.deposition_refusal`).
Deposition.title: Deposition

DepositionEntry.description:
One reading taken at the bench against a runbook's measure (mirrors
`DepositionEntry` in src/data/types.ts): the words the operator said or
typed (`raw`), the number read from them, and whether a person read it
back. A correction is a new entry on the same measure, keeping the `at`
of the reading it corrects and saying when it was typed
(`correctedAt`).
DepositionEntry.title: DepositionEntry

DepositionObservation.description:
Something the operator reported that fits no measure (mirrors
`Observation` in src/data/types.ts): the words kept as they were said,
and a structured reading of them, None until a person adds one.
DepositionObservation.title: DepositionObservation

DepositionReading.description:
GET /api/depositions/readings: one reading a run may take as a
measurement (measurements.py): an entry of one of the project's
depositions that a person confirmed and that stands for its measure,
with the runbook and the measure it was recorded against, the person
who deposited it and the time it was taken. Asked with a unit, a reading
whose unit is that unit or converts into it, its value in that unit
beside its own. A scenario's value names it as `{"value": value, "unit":
unit, "origin": {"kind": "measurement", "ref": ref}}`.
DepositionReading.title: DepositionReading

DroppedCandidate.description:
A candidate anchoring refused (§2.4), kept beside the survivors so the
run can be scored honestly (§6.2): a candidate whose value agreed with a
value a reviewer typed and whose quote failed is a `span_error` in
Witness — the extractor
produced it, and dropping it from BioRepo does not undo that. Never enters
BioRepo; never repaired.
DroppedCandidate.title: DroppedCandidate

EngineConformance.description: An engine's last conformance verdict, at the version it was checked.
EngineConformance.title: EngineConformance

EngineInfo.description: GET /api/engines: one engine as the service found it.
EngineInfo.title: EngineInfo

EngineInput.description:
A value a run sets: a parameter's key and a typed quantity in that
parameter's unit (the shape a run's inputs have), carrying the person or
the model that set it and the day it was set (`origin.at`), as an
Override and a scenario's value carry theirs; or a reading a person
deposited at the bench (a `measurement`, its `ref` the reading's
`<deposition id>/<entry id>`), its value and unit the reading's own,
which the service looks up in the project's depositions before anything
runs, filling the reading's time and its depositor where the request
leaves them out (measurements.py). It holds those fields alone, and a
value, low or high that is true or false is refused, as an Override
refuses one.
EngineInput.title: EngineInput

EngineParameter.description:
One parameter a thing takes: a `ParameterSpec` (the panel's shape,
its bounds with their written reason) with its default value and where
the default comes from, `library-default` naming the package it was read
from or a `convention` saying what the setting is. A thing the project
holds (the train engine's trains) has defaults the project holds too: a
`record` naming the records that bound it, an `artifact` naming the
run, simulation or design it was read from, or a `person-assumption`
naming the person who typed it into the thing. A parameter with no
default has `value` and `origin` null: a run sets it, the engine binds it
from what the project holds (the kinetics engine binds a family's
parameter from the project's records), or the thing fills it itself when
a run leaves it unset, which its `note` then says with the reason (the
train engine's: a value the unit's class decides at run time, a component
the inlet does not carry, a split left to the class). A run that leaves
unset a parameter none of these gives is refused in words, keeping
nothing. The panel's fields an
engine may leave unset default here; `sourceRule` is the rule entry the
origin's kind stands for (`assumption` for a person's), and `assumption`
(a run's value) for a parameter with no default; a record's default
names its field in the rule (`record:<field id>`).
EngineParameter.title: EngineParameter

EnginePrecision.description:
How near a replayed output must come to the run's: within
`atol + rtol·|stored|`.
EnginePrecision.title: EnginePrecision

EngineRun.description: One engine run in a project: a row of `runs` (GET /api/runs).
EngineRun.title: EngineRun

EngineRunRequest.description:
POST /api/engines/{name}/run: one thing, in one configuration, with
the values a person or a model sets, and nothing beside: a field it does
not name, a stray number among them, is refused.
EngineRunRequest.title: EngineRunRequest

EngineThing.description: One thing an engine can run, with the configurations it runs in.
EngineThing.title: EngineThing

Evidence.description: A computed value a plan may cite. Its label is built by code.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceSource.description:
Where an entry came from. For a sign-off, `ref` is what the assessor
names (a protocol id, or a paper training record), and `stepId` the step
when there is one.
EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource

ExtractResponse.description:
What one extraction produced (§6.1, §6.3), and what
`candidates/{paperId}.json` holds.

`candidates` are the survivors of anchoring. `audit` is the event every
one of them shares — the Candidate model carries none (§2.5), so it lives
beside them here and is copied onto a record at promotion (§7).
`rejectionReasons` is keyed by anchoring rule; a rising count is the
signal that the prompt has drifted.
ExtractResponse.title: ExtractResponse

ExtractRun.description: Mirrors the browser's RunOutput: what Witness computes metrics from.
ExtractRun.title: ExtractRun

ExtractRunFalsePositive.description: A candidate a reviewer rejected — the only way one gets here (§6.2).
ExtractRunFalsePositive.title: ExtractRunFalsePositive

ExtractRunResult.description: One reference, a value a reviewer typed, scored against a run (§6.2).
ExtractRunResult.title: ExtractRunResult

ExtractionSummary.description:
What a document's kept extraction found, for the page that lists the
document: when it ran, the candidates anchoring kept and refused, and the
models that answered (the primary, then any it fell back to).
ExtractionSummary.title: ExtractionSummary

FamilyInfo.description: GET /api/fermos/families: a model family as the panel shows it.
FamilyInfo.title: FamilyInfo

FermosBinding.description:
GET /api/fermos/bind (OF-BLD-020 §3.2): a family's parameters bound
for a strain, product and sugar from a fit, the records, a kept
simulation and the conventions, starting no integration.
FermosBinding.title: FermosBinding

FermosFitInfo.description:
A kinetic fit or a forecast fermOS keeps, and what it can feed one
shelf flowsheet (GET /api/fermos/fits). A person picks it; a model never
does.
FermosFitInfo.title: FermosFitInfo

FermosHarvest.description: GET /api/fermos/harvest: a kept simulation's broth at an hour.
FermosHarvest.title: FermosHarvest

FermosSeries.description: One measure's readings in time order, as the browser's `seriesOf` makes them.
FermosSeries.title: FermosSeries

FetchLicense.description:
What the JATS <license> element said, or what an OSTI report or an SGD
strain entry states of itself. Stored beside every fetched text, because
Europe PMC's open-access subset spans several licences and the text is
kept local partly on that account (§2.2).
FetchLicense.title: FetchLicense

FetchedSection.description: One section of a paper's own text. Same shape as PaperSection.
FetchedSection.title: FetchedSection

FitFeed.description:
What one fermOS artifact gives one input of a flowsheet: the value in
the input's unit, with the 5th and 95th percentile of the forecast's band
for readings, or why it gives nothing, in words naming the parameter.
FitFeed.title: FitFeed

FitParam.description: One fitted parameter, its 95 % interval and its unit.
FitParam.title: FitParam

FlowsheetInput.description:
One input a shelf flowsheet takes. It names the ontology fields whose
records bind it; with none, a named person's assumption or a stated
convention sets it. The file of the flowsheet holds no value for it.
FlowsheetInput.title: FlowsheetInput

ForecastRequest.description:
POST /api/fermos/forecast: a band for the next run, drawn from a fit.
Its start values and length are the values of the forecast's scope
`fermos:forecast:<fit id>`, each keyed as the scope names it (x0, s0, p0
and t_end, fermos.FORECAST_KEYS) and typed as a quantity with its
origin, the person or the model that set it and the day it was set;
the ones left unset are the fitted run's own. It holds these fields and
no other: a field it does not name is refused.
ForecastRequest.title: ForecastRequest

GeneosModelInfo.description: One model on geneOS's shelf, as the browser lists it.
GeneosModelInfo.title: GeneosModelInfo

GeneosResult.description:
A ceiling, a frontier or a sugar mix: an artifact and its evidence, or
a finding in words with no number.
GeneosResult.title: GeneosResult

GridDim.description:
One axis of a run's grid: the input it walks, by key, and the values
it takes, in the input's unit.
GridDim.title: GridDim

GrowthFit.description: ln X against t over the best window of four or more readings.
GrowthFit.title: GrowthFit

Guild.description: A project's ledger — the people and everything recorded about them.
Guild.title: Guild

GuildEvidence.description:
One thing a person did that bears on one skill. Append-only: a mistake
is withdrawn, never edited, and the withdrawal stays on the entry.
GuildEvidence.title: GuildEvidence

GuildPerson.description:
One person on the ledger. `id` is chosen by the browser so a person
added offline keeps their id when it is posted later.
GuildPerson.title: GuildPerson

GuildPolicy.description:
The lead's choices for the team (OF-BLD-013 §5.1). In advise mode the
run-mode gate warns and records a deviation; in enforce mode it holds the
step until a cosigner is recorded, or someone qualified takes over. Set
per criticality: a routine skill and a critical one can differ.
GuildPolicy.title: GuildPolicy

GuildWithdrawal.description: A request to withdraw one entry: who, when, and why.
GuildWithdrawal.title: GuildWithdrawal

HarvestState.description: One state of the simulation at the hour read, in the unit it keeps.
HarvestState.title: HarvestState

Health.description:
GET /api/health: the service answering, the models a call goes to
(the primary, and the one a call falls back to), and whether it holds a
key, so a page can say the service is up with no key to call a model
with.
Health.title: Health

KeptTrain.description:
A train a model built with `pureos_build` or `pureos_write`, kept by
the service with who made it and when: the train as data (D9). Its runs
are `pureos.train_run` artifacts, found by the train's id.
KeptTrain.title: KeptTrain

KineticFit.description:
Logistic growth, Luedeking–Piret production and the substrate balance
(`logistic_v0`), or a kinetics family fitted to the same series
(OF-BLD-020 §3.1).
KineticFit.title: KineticFit

LibraryBuild.description:
Whether a plant built here in one configuration (None: its own), as
the discovery command found when it built each: its units and whether a
TEA prices it, or the package's own error.
LibraryBuild.title: LibraryBuild

LibraryCompat.description:
A change a plant needs to build under the pinned BioSTEAM, and why;
stated in the basis of every run of the plant.
LibraryCompat.title: LibraryCompat

LibraryEntryParameter.description: One parameter of a plant's entry point, as its signature states it.
LibraryEntryParameter.title: LibraryEntryParameter

LibraryParameters.description:
A library plant's parameters as the package builds it
(GET /api/library/{plant}/parameters): each as a ParameterSpec, its
value read back with origin `library-default`, and how the plant's
system, TEA, feedstock and product were found.
LibraryParameters.title: LibraryParameters

LibraryPlant.description:
One subpackage of the installed `biorefineries` (GET /api/library):
a plant with an entry point, a package of subsystem factories alone, or
one that offers neither; or one of openFerment's own flowsheets
(`flowsheet`), composed from a package's factories by its recipe and run
through the same adapter.
LibraryPlant.title: LibraryPlant

LibraryRunRequest.description:
POST /api/library/{plant}/run: the configuration (None: the plant's
default, as the biosteam engine names it), the values set for the run,
and who asks for the run. It holds these fields alone: a field it does
not name is refused.
LibraryRunRequest.title: LibraryRunRequest

LibraryScenarioField.description: One field of a ProcessModel's scenario, with the package's default.
LibraryScenarioField.title: LibraryScenarioField

LibraryShelf.description: What discovery read of the installed package, and when.
LibraryShelf.title: LibraryShelf

LiteratureQuestion.description:
POST /api/literature/answer: a question for a cited answer over the
project's documents.
LiteratureQuestion.title: LiteratureQuestion

LiteratureStats.description:
GET /api/literature/stats, in the kit's own names: the project's
documents, their chunks and their citations, counted by licence class,
source and embedding version; the concept graph's entities,
relationships and communities are the instance's, counted whole.
LiteratureStats.title: LiteratureStats

LiveConversation.description:
A Postdoc conversation, its turns oldest first (mirrors
`LiveConversation` in src/data/types.ts; GET /api/conversations/{id}).
LiveConversation.title: LiveConversation

LiveTurn.description:
One turn of a Postdoc conversation (mirrors `LiveTurn` in
src/data/types.ts): the question, its loop's steps, the validated plan or
the failure in words, and its status. The service keeps it
(postdoc/conversations.py) with who asked and the artifacts its tool calls
produced; a turn the service was answering when it stopped reads
`interrupted`.
LiveTurn.title: LiveTurn

MeasuredConditions.description:
What a measured value was true under: the protocol it was run under
(None for readings taken with no protocol's steps), the scale and the
strain the runbook names.
MeasuredConditions.title: MeasuredConditions

MeasuredEvidence.description:
A measured value a reconciliation released (mirrors `MeasuredEvidence`
in src/data/types.ts): evidence about the run that produced it, kept with
its conditions and the run's deviations, and linked to the prediction it
tests.
MeasuredEvidence.title: MeasuredEvidence

ModuleCoverage.description: What the sweep found in one module.
ModuleCoverage.title: ModuleCoverage

ModuleRow.description:
One row a module's read tool returns (OF-BLD-015 §7.2): what the
module holds, where it stands, and how it is marked.
ModuleRow.title: ModuleRow

NotOffered.description:
A parameter the class's constructor takes that the panel does not
offer, and why, in words.
NotOffered.title: NotOffered

Overlay.description:
GET /api/biorepo/overlay (§2.1). The browser's store applies it in one
action when it arrives; a project's records reach the page through it.

`papers`, the documents the project holds in the kit (ADR-002); `runs`
and `candidates` recomputed from the project's candidates against the
values reviewers typed by `witness.py` (§6.2); `records` from the
project's decisions (§7).

`candidates` and `runs` are a LIST OR NULL (OF-BLD-012.1 F3). The service
always sends the full list, so an empty list means the extractor produced
nothing and the store drops what it had. `None` means "not supplied" and
the store keeps what it had — nothing here sends it, and it exists so that
"empty" and "unknown" can never be the same value again.
Overlay.title: Overlay

OverlayPaper.description:
One document the project holds, as the overlay carries it (§2.1;
ADR-002): its passages in the kit as its sections, its citation, its
licence and who served it, and what its kept extraction found. The
browser makes a paper of it, which BioRepo, the review card, the reader
and Witness read.
OverlayPaper.title: OverlayPaper

Override.description:
A change to one parameter of one scope for a run (D3): a named
person's assumption, a model's estimate (ADR-006), `by` naming the
person or the model, or a deposition's reading (a measurement), `by` the
person who deposited it, `at` the time it was taken and `ref` the
reading, `<deposition id>/<entry id>`.
Override.title: Override

OxygenUptake.description:
OUR(t) = qO2·X on the time course's hours, and its peak read on the
solver's own steps.
OxygenUptake.title: OxygenUptake

PackageRegression.description:
A plant's regression values, read from its package's installed test
file: which package, which file, which test.
PackageRegression.title: PackageRegression

ParamResolveRequest.description:
POST /api/params/{scope}/resolve. Runs nothing. It holds these
fields alone: a field it does not name is refused.
ParamResolveRequest.title: ParamResolveRequest

ParamScope.description: GET /api/params/{scope}: a scope's specs with their current values.
ParamScope.title: ParamScope

ParameterSpec.description:
One parameter as its model, unit or flowsheet declares it. No value
lives here but the stated convention and the bounds, each with its
reason.
ParameterSpec.title: ParameterSpec

ParameterValue.description: A parameter's value in one scope, with where it came from.
ParameterValue.title: ParameterValue

Passage.description: A piece of a fetched paper's own text, as a search returns it.
Passage.title: Passage

PassageRef.description: A sentence a claim quotes, and the passage it stands in.
PassageRef.title: PassageRef

PasteRequest.description:
POST /api/intake/paste: text a person pasted, its title, where it came
from, the licence class they chose and what they say of the licence.
PasteRequest.title: PasteRequest

Practice.description: A project's Practice — every scenario drafted and every session held.
Practice.title: Practice

PracticeDeposition.description:
A Deposition as the page sends it for drafting: the project keeps its
depositions as rows (project_state.py), and a draft reads the ones the
page sends.
PracticeDeposition.title: PracticeDeposition

PracticeObservation.description:
What the tutor observed, in plain words, with the steps it bears on.
No grade: the schema has no field for one.
PracticeObservation.title: PracticeObservation

PracticeSource.description:
What a value in the evidence pane was copied from: a protocol step or
material, or a Deposition's entry or observation.
PracticeSource.title: PracticeSource

PracticeValue.description:
One item in a scenario's evidence pane. `label` is the model's words
naming it; `text`, `value`, `unit` and `at` are the source's, copied by
the service.
PracticeValue.title: PracticeValue

PredictedOutput.description:
One output of an engine run a runbook predicts: its key (`values.<name>`
of the run's outputs.values, for a run of any engine; for a library run
`outputs.<key>` of a flowsheet's outputs or `price.<key>` of the price as
well) and what the bench calls it.
PredictedOutput.title: PredictedOutput

PriorTurn.description:
One earlier turn of the conversation a follow-up belongs to, in words:
the question as the person asked it, and the claims' text, the gaps and
the decline of the plan that answered it. The validator already held each
of these to Rule 1; the loop drops any that still holds a number. No id,
value or quote travels: a follow-up searches again before it cites.
PriorTurn.title: PriorTurn

ProductPropertyRequest.description:
`POST /api/protparam` and `POST /api/thermo/volatility`: the product,
by its id. Nothing else is taken, a sequence least of all.
ProductPropertyRequest.title: ProductPropertyRequest

ProformaRunRequest.description:
POST /api/proforma/run. It holds these fields alone: a field it does
not name is refused.
ProformaRunRequest.title: ProformaRunRequest

ProformaScenario.description:
A scenario a person made in Proforma (mirrors `Scenario` in
src/data/types.ts): the shelf flowsheet it runs (`modelId`), its name,
whether it is pinned, and, on `custom_train_v1`, the kept vessel design
and train run it is built from. A row an earlier page wrote keeps the
fields it carried beside these, alpha 1.0's `dims`, `point` and
`assumptions` among them.
ProformaScenario.title: ProformaScenario

ProformaTables.description:
What a reader takes from a `proforma.run` artifact (proforma.tables_of):
the flowsheet, what made the tables, and the tables themselves.
ProformaTables.title: ProformaTables

Project.description:
What scopes a lab's documents, records, flowsheets, runs, artifacts,
runbooks, depositions, conversations and Guild entries: every row the
service keeps belongs to one.
Project.title: Project

ProjectCreate.description: POST /api/projects. `id` is made from the name when left out.
ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate

ProjectState.description:
GET /api/state: everything the project keeps of the work done in its
pages, keyed as the page keeps it (src/lib/projectState.ts), each row read
as its kind's model. A row that does not read is named in `refused` with
why, and every other row is served beside it.
ProjectState.title: ProjectState

Proposal.description:
What a model asked for at a gate (OF-BLD-015 §7.4), until a person
carries it out or dismisses it on Home.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProposalAction.description: A person carrying out or dismissing a proposal.
ProposalAction.title: ProposalAction

ProposalMissing.description: A property the rules needed and nothing holds, and why.
ProposalMissing.title: ProposalMissing

ProposalReason.description:
Why one unit of a proposal is there: the rule, the property it read,
the artifact that holds that property (None when the products
catalogue states it), and the words, which carry no number.
ProposalReason.title: ProposalReason

ProposeRequest.description: POST /api/pureos/propose: ids and words, never a number.
ProposeRequest.title: ProposeRequest

Quantity.description:
A value and its unit; a categorical field carries a string value. A
number a model, a person or a library supplies carries its origin
(ADR-006); a value code derives from another (the SI form of a record's
value) carries none, the thing it was derived from being its source.
Quantity.title: Quantity

Reconciliation.description:

get.description:
A scope's parameters (`ParamScope`): every spec with its bounds and
their reason, and its value as the service binds it now, with its
source. `proforma:<scenario id>` is a scenario the project keeps, or
with `?flowsheet=` one not yet saved; `?host=` and `?fits=` (JSON)
bind as `/api/proforma/bind` does. Binding only: it starts no worker,
integrates nothing and keeps nothing. `fermos:vessel:<id>` (with
`?vesselType=`) reads its class's defaults through the Proforma worker,
which a read starts when it is cold (OF-BLD-020 §4.1). `fermos:family:<id>`
binds as GET /api/fermos/bind does, from `?strain=`, `?product=`,
`?sugar=`, `?fit=`, `?startFrom=` and `?durationPreset=` (OF-BLD-020
§3.2). `pureos:unit:<train>:<unit>` takes
the unit's catalogue type as `?unitType=` and reads its class's defaults
through the Proforma worker as the vessel's do (§5.1); with no type it is
a 404 in words. With `?train=` (the whole TrainSpec, JSON, §5.2) the unit is
the train's own, its per-component keys expanded over the train's
chemicals and its records bound from the evidence pool by each parameter's field, and
`pureos:unit:<train>:inlet` is the train's inlet. A `proforma:` scope on
`custom_train_v1` names its vessel design and train run (`?vessel=`,
`?trainRun=`; OF-BLD-020 §6.1) and serves the group Finance, read from
the installed package with no worker. 404 for a scope no provider here
knows; 422 in words for a malformed one or a refused binding; 409 for an
artifact the scope names that is damaged on disk, as the vessel's own route
answers it (§2.R, finding 17); 503 when the worker cannot answer.

404.description: The project the request names is one the database does not hold, in words.

post.description:
Run one tool through the registry, the same path Postdoc's loop and
the MCP server take, in the request's project. A refusal is a result
with `error` set; an unknown tool is a 404. The body is the tool's
input. The caller is named one of two ways, each name read as the tool
door reads one (its control, format and surrogate characters dropped,
its whitespace collapsed, at most 200 characters), and a call naming
both is a 422 in words. `?by=` names a person, who is the author of any
quantity the input types (ADR-006) and of any write it makes: the audit
row, a proposal and what the write keeps are marked as that person's,
and a store that holds a model's work alone (pureOS's kept trains)
refuses the write in its words. `X-OpenFerment-Assistant` names an
outside assistant, and the call runs in the model's lane under that
name, through this door (`via: http`): a number it types is that name's
estimate, a write is marked with that name (`by`), its audit row names
it as `who` with agent `model`, `via` http in its detail and no effort,
and a catalogue entry's source reads "<name>/<version>, at the HTTP
endpoint". A tool that writes (`writes` in docs/TOOLS.md) is run only for
a caller named so: a call that names nobody is a 422 in words, and
nothing runs.
